$description: Colour pairs that must meet a contrast minimum in every theme (spec §6, WCAG 2.2 AA). Checked by tools/contrast-check.mjs; a failure fails the build. Each rule checks every fg against every bg. Exempt by design: color-text-disabled, color-border-subtle (decorative), color-brand-* (decoration only), color-scrim.

rules.why: Body, headings and secondary text on every surface except inverse (1.4.3)
Text on the inverse surface (tooltips, inverse bands)
Links and their hover state on every surface
Secondary button label, at rest and on hover
Tones are text-safe on every surface (Card exponent, Badge soft and outline, Progress)
Badge solid and Avatar: page colour as text on a tone fill
Status text and icons on their own fill
Status text and icons on their own fill
Status text and icons on their own fill
Status text and icons on their own fill
Status text and icons on any page surface
Control outlines: inputs, checkbox, radio, switch track; the off switch thumb on its track (1.4.11)
Checked switch track and checkbox fill against the page (1.4.11)
Body outline: region outlines and the selected fill against the surfaces the figure sits on, and so against the unselected fill (1.4.11)
